# Support

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](SUPPORT.vi.md)

## Before asking for help

Please read [README.md](../README.md), [docs/KAGGLE.md](../docs/KAGGLE.md), and [docs/API.md](../docs/API.md).

For Kaggle runtime problems, include:

- the exact Git commit shown by the notebook;
- whether `RUN_TPU_VALIDATION` was `True` or `False`;
- the failing phase: setup, TPU preflight, model load, readiness, text, or vision;
- the relevant error message with secrets removed;
- whether Kaggle reported 8 TPU devices.

## Where to ask

Use a GitHub issue for reproducible bugs or feature requests. Choose the provided issue template so the report contains enough information to investigate.

Do not use public issues for security vulnerabilities or sensitive runtime data; follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

## Scope of support

This repository focuses on the provided Kaggle TPU v5e-8 workflow. Other clouds, TPU generations, local TPU setups, different model families, and production hosting may require separate adaptation.
